name: Bamboo-tube rice
summary: Sticky rice packed in a bamboo tube, closed with banana leaf or fresh leaf, and heated on a wood fire until the shell chars. Split the tube and eat it with the grilled fish.
origin: The Thái table. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, 21 March 2020. Báo Sơn La, 4 September 2020.
howToEat: From the tube, with the grilled fish or on its own. A salt dip was not in those two accounts.
where: Bản Mòng and the town table. The Mộc Châu tube stays on that plateau. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Com lam in Son La — bamboo-tube rice, two methods
seoDescription: Cơm lam in Sơn La. The museum handbook uses new sticky rice and lá rong or banana leaf. Báo Sơn La soaks nếp nương overnight.
